source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the reactions of carboxylic acids (PDF 110-111).

blocks.text: Carboxylic acids ke reactions teen qism ke hain: sirf tezaabi hydrogen ke, -OH group badalne wale, aur poore carboxyl group ke.
Carboxylic acids wazeh taur par tezaabi hain kyunke paani mein H+ ions dete hain, is liye fa'aal dhaaton, alkalis, carbonates aur hydrogencarbonates se react karte hain:

items: SOCl2, PCl3 ya PCl5 se acyl chlorides bante hain: CH3COOH + SOCl2 -> CH3COCl + HCl + SO2; CH3COOH + PCl5 -> CH3COCl + HCl + POCl3; 3CH3COOH + PCl3 -> 3CH3COCl + H3PO3 (garmi).
Alcohols se (esterification), garhe sulphuric acid ke saath garam karne par esters bante hain: CH3COOH + C2H5OH <=> CH3COOC2H5 + H2O (ethyl ethanoate).

blocks.text: Taqatwar reducing agent lithium tetrahydridoaluminate(III), LiAlH4, carboxylic acids ko primary alcohols mein reduce karta hai: CH3COOH + 4[H] -> CH3CH2OH + H2O. Aam reducing agents H2/Ni aur sodium tetrahydridoborate(III), NaBH4, carboxylic acids ko reduce nahi karte.

Methanoic acid, HCOOH, kamzor aur taqatwar dono oxidising agents se oxidise hota hai, kyunke is ke molecule mein carboxyl hisse ke saath aldehyde jaisa hissa (H-C=O) bhi hai; is liye yeh taqatwar reducing agent hai. Yeh wahid monocarboxylic acid hai jo Tollens' reagent ke saath chandi ka aaina aur Fehling's solution ke saath eent jaisa surkh precipitate deta hai, jo is ki pehchan mein use hote hain: HCOOH + 2[Ag(NH3)2]OH -> 2Ag + CO2 + 4NH3 + 2H2O; HCOOH + 2Cu(OH)2 -> Cu2O + CO2 + 3H2O.

Ethanedioic acid, HOOC-COOH, tezaabi KMnO4 (ya K2Cr2O7) se carbon dioxide aur paani mein oxidise hota hai: 2KMnO4 + 3H2SO4 + 5(COOH)2 -> K2SO4 + 2MnSO4 + 10CO2 + 8H2O. Manganese +7 se +2 aur carbon +3 se +4 par jata hai.

blocks.alt: Mua'adlat ke teen panel. A, tezaabi hydrogen: ethanoic acid Na, NaOH, Na2CO3 aur NaHCO3 ke saath. B, -OH badalna: SOCl2 aur PCl5 se ethanoyl chloride, aur ethanol se esterification. C: LiAlH4 se ethanol mein reduction (H2/Ni ya NaBH4 se nahi), Tollens' reagent se methanoic acid ki oxidation, aur tezaabi KMnO4 se ethanedioic acid ki oxidation.
blocks.caption: Carboxylic acids ke reactions (kitab ke mua'adlon ka asal khulasa).
blocks.long_description: Tezaabi hydrogen dhaat se badal kar namak banta; -OH group Cl ya alkoxy group se badalta; aur poora carboxyl group CH2OH mein reduce hota hai. Methanoic aur ethanedioic acids mustasna hain jo mazeed carbon dioxide tak oxidise ho sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Sodium hydrogencarbonate ethanoic acid aur phenol ko kaise alag pehchanta hai?
blocks.explanation: Ethanoic acid itna taqatwar hai ke NaHCO3 se react kar ke CO2 ke bulbule deta hai; phenol bohat kamzor tezaab hai aur bulbule nahi deta.

items: Tezaabi H: Na, NaOH, Na2CO3, NaHCO3 ke saath namak (CO2 ke bulbule).
-OH badla: SOCl2/PCl3/PCl5 se acyl chlorides; alcohols se esters (garha H2SO4).
LiAlH4 tezaabon ko primary alcohols mein reduce karta; HCOOH aur (COOH)2 CO2 tak oxidise ho sakte.
